notes.title: Small Bugfix Update - Patch Notes (v010)
notes.notes:

[*]Fixed lock not unlocking in some cases when placing a rotated button on the unlocking area.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE: Added keyboard support to the demo!
notes.notes:
[p]Hi! Just updated the demo with a few bug fixes and keyboard support.
[/p][p][b]Added keyboard support[/b][/p][p]Use WASD or arrows to control the player, but only if the button is available on the screen. A list of the shortcuts can now be viewed in the pause menu.[/p][p]Player movement: WASD/Arrows
Undo/Redo: Z/X
Restart: R

[i]Pink[/i] Undo/Redo: SHIFT + Z/X
[i]Pink[/i] Restart: SHIFT + R[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45567286/5d91507822dd4faf6652ae1447145c62239d5197.png"][/img][/p]
